programme.desc: A bad wolf lives next to three little pigs, Heimlich, Dieter and Chef.The first of them discovers that under the influence of the moon he transforms into a woman who is obsessed with catching pigs.

programme.title: Bohemian Rhapsody
programme.desc: London, 1970.Farrokh "Freddie" Bulsara (Rami Malek) works at Heathrow Airport.One day he meets Mary Austin (Lucy Boynton), who becomes his girlfriend.He also meets members of the band Smile - drummer Roger Taylor (Ben Hardy) and guitarist Brian May (Gwilym Lee).The musicians are looking for a new vocalist.It becomes Freddie.Additionally, bassist John Deacon (Joe Mazzello) joins the group.Some time later they record their debut album.Soon, Freddie changes the band's name to Queen and his surname to Mercury.The artists come under the wing of manager John Reid (Aidan Gillen) and release a new album, and then go on tour around the United States.Even though Freddie proposes to Mary, during the trip he begins to question his own sexuality.In 1975, the album "A Night at the Opera" was released, which included, among others:the song "Bohemian Rhapsody".The composition becomes the reason for the breakup with the current manager, but also makes the musicians real stars.

programme.title: Harry Potter and the Prisoner of Azkaban
programme.desc: 13-year-old Harry Potter spends his next holidays with his aunt and uncle, the Dursleys.So far, he has been very obedient and has never once used magic outside his school, in accordance with the regulations in force.Eventually, however, his mischievous Aunt Marge throws him off balance.Using his magical skills, the boy causes the woman to inflate like a balloon and fly away.Harry, terrified by the prospect of the punishment his guardians would surely inflict on him, runs away from them at night.The Knight-Errant's multi-decker bus takes him to a pub where the Minister of Magic, Cornelius Fudge, is waiting for him.He offers the young wizard a place to stay.His strange behavior catches Potter's attention.It turns out that Sirius Black escaped from Azkaban.He allegedly caused the death of Harry's parents, and now he plans to kill their son.Hogwarts is guarded by Dementors, who are the guards of Azkaban.Harry feels paralyzing fear of them.He must defeat him to face the enemy.

programme.title: The Doll
programme.desc: Rémi did not recover from the breakup.In order to function, he remains in a relationship with the doll Audrey, with whom he lives and shares everyday affairs.One day, a new colleague shows up at his company.

programme.title: Maid in Manhattan
programme.desc: New York.Divorcee Marisa Ventura (Jennifer Lopez) raises her son alone.She works as a maid at the luxurious Beresford Hotel in Manhattan.While cleaning the apartment of aristocrat Caroline Lane (Natasha Richardson), the woman tries on her elegant outfit, in which she looks exceptionally nice.Another hotel guest sees her so changed.He is lawyer Christopher Matthew (Ralph Fiennes), running for parliament.He takes Marisa as a person of a similar social status to himself.They go for a walk together and then eat dinner together.The woman cannot bring herself to correct the mistake, especially since she likes Christopher.However, it is not known how the future senator will react to the fact that his chosen one is an ordinary girl from the Bronx... The luxurious Beresford hotel, where the main character of the film works, is in fact the famous Waldorf-Astoria on Park Avenue.

credits.actor: Christopher 'Chris' Marshall, N.Y. Assemblyman - Ralph Fiennes
John Bextrum, Personnel Manager - Chris Eigeman

programme.title: Dune: Part Two
programme.desc: After an insidious attack by the Harkonnens and the death of his father, Paul Atreides (Timothée Chalamet) and his pregnant mother, Jessica (Rebecca Ferguson), hide in the desert among the Fremen.There, a young man's feelings for Chani (Zendaya) sprout.At the same time, he matures spiritually.The leader of the wandering people, Stilgar (Javier Bardem), closely observes the only descendant of the Atreides family and becomes convinced that he is the chosen one, whose coming has been predicted for generations.However, to be accepted by the Fremen, Paul must pass the ultimate test by riding a monstrous worm.Meanwhile, Baron Vladimir Harkonnen (Stellan Skarsgard) finds out that Paul is alive.He knows he has to hurry.He decides to take control of the entire planet Arrakis.He starts launching attack after attack.A continuation of the spectacular production from 2021, which was awarded six Oscars.Both films are adaptations of the famous science fiction novel by Frank Herbert.

programme.title: Focus
programme.desc: Nicky Spurgeon is a calculating fraud.The model's appearance and ability to keep cool make him a master criminal.He is able to win people over, but he does it to take advantage of them.One day, in a restaurant, he meets a fair-haired beauty, Jess Barrett, whose ambition is to pursue a criminal career.He becomes her mentor.Over time, they both realize that they have much more in common than the relationship of master and disciple.However, they live in a world where there is no place for love.Spurgeon ends this relationship.Three years pass.Nicky is in Buenos Aires, where he works for the owner of a car racing team, Rafael Garrigi.He meets his former lover here.Aware of her strengths, the femme fatale has one goal - to take revenge for the way she was once treated.

programme.title: Wuthering Heights
programme.desc: Yorkshire.Catherine Earnshaw (Margot Robbie) begins a love relationship with the stray Heathcliff (Jacob Elordi), taken in by her father.The forbidden feeling has a destructive effect on both of them.

programme.title: Euphoria
programme.desc: The further fate of a group of friends who left school behind and entered adulthood.The action moves forward several years.Rue (Zendaya Coleman) is no longer a lost teenager, but a person involved in the criminal world.He goes to interrogation in connection with smuggling drugs from Mexico.Cassie (Sydney Sweeney) and Maddy's (Alexa Demie) relationship has improved, but old wounds haven't healed at all.The first woman's relationship with Nate (Jacob Elordi) develops, but not towards a happy ending.The remaining characters confront their own choices, addiction and violence.They are looking for redemption and answers to the question about their place in the world.

programme.title: Peacemaker 2
programme.desc: Two years have passed since the last events.Chris Smith (John Cena) considers himself a real hero.However, he must earn the recognition of other heroes.

programme.title: NO
programme.desc: Animal tamer OJ Haywood (Daniel Kaluuya) and his sister Emerald (Keke Palmer) live on a ranch in southern California where horses are trained for Hollywood film productions.They take over the business of their father, who died in suspicious circumstances.Problems are piling up for them.One day they become witnesses of inexplicable phenomena.Together with a former child star (Steven Yeun), an emcee at a family amusement park, they try to film supernatural incidents to make money by selling sensational materials.Their actions have unforeseen consequences.Director Jordan Peele made his debut in 2017 with the acclaimed thriller "Get Out!", for which he won an Oscar for the script.

programme.title: Man on Fire
programme.desc: American John Creasy (Denzel Washington) is a man haunted by nightmares from his past.He is a former assassin who worked for the CIA for many years.Frustrated, he avoids people and seeks solace in alcohol.Creasy comes to Mexico to visit his old friend and colleague, Rayburn (Christopher Walken).The city is currently gripped by a wave of kidnappings for ransom.Rich residents panic and many of them hire security guards to ensure the safety of their children.A friend finds John a job as a bodyguard for ten-year-old Pita Ramos (Dakota Fanning), the daughter of Mexican industrialist Samuel Ramos (Marc Anthony) and his American wife Lisa (Radha Mitchell).At first, Creasy has a hard time coping with the girl's presence.Over time, however, he becomes friends with her.Under its influence, he changes his attitude to life and gives up alcohol.Soon, however, little Pita is kidnapped.The desperate man does everything to save her.

programme.title: Neighbors 2: Sorority Rising
programme.desc: Mac (Seth Rogen) and Kelly (Rose Byrne) Radner have decided to sell their house and move to a better neighborhood.They are thirty trial days away from finalizing the contract, during which time potential buyers can conduct an inspection and, if they don't like anything, break the contract.It's bad luck that students from the Kappa Nu sorority show up in the area.Shelby (Chloë Grace Moretz), Beth (Kiersey Clemons) and Nora (Beanie Feldstein) - just like their predecessors - love to throw parties.The Radners must enlist the help of their old enemy, Teddy Sanders (Zac Efron).The recent college star is struggling with his own issues.Lonely, he wants to be needed by someone at all costs.

programme.title: Olivia and the Invisible Earthquake
programme.desc: Twelve-year-old Olivia, together with her younger brother Tim and her mother, must suddenly leave their current apartment and start all over again in a strange neighborhood.Wanting to protect Tim from fear and alleviate his sense of loss, the girl tells him that their move is part of the film in which he is the main character.This challenge to their imagination helps them come to terms with difficult reality.Over time, through new friendships, fun, and even a bit of magic, the siblings discover that they can truly take responsibility for their story.

programme.title: Focus
programme.desc: Nicky Spurgeon is a calculating fraud.The model's appearance and ability to keep cool make him a master criminal.He is able to win people over, but he does it to take advantage of them.One day, in a restaurant, he meets a fair-haired beauty, Jess Barrett, whose ambition is to pursue a criminal career.He becomes her mentor.Over time, they both realize that they have much more in common than the relationship of master and disciple.However, they live in a world where there is no place for love.Spurgeon ends this relationship.Three years pass.Nicky is in Buenos Aires, where he works for the owner of a car racing team, Rafael Garrigi.He meets his former lover here.Aware of her strengths, the femme fatale has one goal - to take revenge for the way she was once treated.

programme.title: Stranger Than Fiction
programme.desc: Harold Crick is a lonely clerk who carefully plans each day.One day he discovers that he is constantly accompanied by a mysterious narrative coming from nowhere.A female voice constantly comments on all his actions.A concerned man goes to a psychiatrist, but he cannot determine what may be wrong with his patient.Literature specialist, Professor Jules Hilbert, suggests to Harold that he is the hero of a book by the famous writer, Karen Eiffel.What's worse, the author usually annihilates the main characters of her works.Crick finds the woman and begs her to spare his life.The eccentric artist suffers from a lack of creative inspiration.Despite the support of his assistant, Penny, he has trouble figuring out how to get rid of Harold.He does everything he can to stop the writer before inspiration returns to her.

programme.title: Harry Potter and the Goblet of Fire
programme.desc: Harry Potter begins his fourth year at the School of Witchcraft and Wizardry.The Triwizard Tournament is also approaching, with representatives of the three most prestigious universities taking part: Hogwarts, Beauxbatons and Durmstrang.The Goblet of Fire predicts the players.Harry Potter is also one of the lucky ones, even though he has not reached the required age.The young wizard's friends, Hermione and Ron, sense that there is some trick behind it.Regardless of the suspicions, the boy must face three competition tasks.In addition, he must also face his greatest enemy - Lord Voldemort.The fourth volume of the popular series of novels by J.K.Rowling was successfully brought to the screen by Mike Newell, the creator of the hits "Four Weddings and a Funeral" and "Donnie Brasco".The film received, among others:Oscar nomination for scenography.

programme.title: Sarah Bernhardt, la divine
programme.desc: The beginning of the 20th century.The outstanding French actress Sarah Bernhardt (Sandrine Kiberlain) is considered one of the most important artists of her time and has the status of an international star.Her admirers include Oscar Wilde, Alfons Mucha and Victor Hugo.Her talent and extraordinary charisma, as well as her courage and extravagant lifestyle are widely admired.The actress disrupted social norms and shocked her contemporaries with her unusual preferences and numerous love affairs.She was a declared opponent of anti-Semitism.Fate connected her most closely with the actor Lucien Guitry (Laurent Lafitte) and the painter Louise Abbéma (Amira Casar).Since her fateful fall on stage in 1905 in Rio de Janeiro, Divine Sarah has been struggling with terrible knee pain, which over the years has made it impossible for her to move.In order to be able to perform, after a decade, the actress makes a dramatic decision.Full of passion and inner strength, the artist will forever be remembered in the history of art and culture.

programme.title: The Last Showgirl
programme.desc: After thirty years, dancer Shelly Gardner (Pamela Anderson) ends her career.For decades, she performed in a strip revue in Las Vegas, which was inspired by French burlesque.The stage, costumes and music are her passion, for which she sacrificed her family life and relationship with her daughter, Hannah (Billie Lourd).She shared her knowledge and experience with beginner friends Marianne (Brenda Song) and Jodie (Kiernan Shipka).One day, however, producer Eddie (Dave Bautista) announces that the show has been canceled.Devastated, Shelly must re-plan her future.A similar fate will befall her friend Annette (Jamie Lee Curtis), a dealer at an arcade.Golden Globe for Pamela Anderson.

programme.title: Anaconda
programme.desc: Doug (Jack Black) and Griff (Paul Rudd) have been friends since childhood.They have always dreamed of making a remake of their favorite film, the horror film "Anaconda".When both buddies experience a midlife crisis, they decide not to wait any longer and set off together deep into the Amazon to start filming.The situation becomes more complicated when... a real giant anaconda appears on the film set, spreading chaos and destruction around.Despite the deadly threat, the friends decide to take advantage of the predator's presence.

programme.title: We're the Millers
programme.desc: Small-time marijuana dealer David Clark tries to help teenagers living in his neighborhood.He is attacked by three homeless punks and robbed of his goods and cash.As a result, he becomes indebted to his supplier, Brad Gurdlinger.To repay the debt, he must import the latest batch of stimulants from Mexico.To conceal himself, he arranges helpers to pretend to be his immediate family going on holiday with him.So David's neighbors go on the road with him: cynical stripper Rose O'Reilly, the drug dealer's would-be client, the dim-witted Kenny Rossmore, and the smart, street-savvy teenager Casey Mathis.A laugh-out-loud action movie full of well-acted episodes and indecent gags.This is another joint project of Jason Sudeikis and Jennifer Aniston, after the comedies "Get Your Ex" and "Horrible Bosses".

programme.title: Amrum
programme.desc: Spring 1945. Twelve-year-old Nanning hunts seals and works hard in the fields to help his mother.He faces difficult decisions.

While there, she reminisces with friends and fans and begins a whirlwind romance with musician Mickey Deans, her soon-to-be fifth husband.

Thrust into the spotlight, Rachel must now contend with jealous socialites, quirky relatives and something far, far worse -- Nick's disapproving mother.

Meanwhile, Iosef's father (Michael Nyqvist) -- John's former colleague -- puts a huge bounty on John's head.

programme.title: The Last Duel
programme.desc: France, 14th century.Marquerite de Carrouges (Jodie Comer) accuses Jacques le Gris (Adam Driver) of rape.The man was once friends with her husband, Jean (Matt Damon), from a respectable family.They shed blood together in battles, but later their paths diverged.They were divided by a fight for money and influence.Favored by Count Pierre d'Alencon (Ben Affleck), the less connected, but ambitious and educated Jacques won further honors.However, it was Jean who married a beautiful, proud and intelligent woman who also caught the attention of his companion.Now the knight must defend her and his honor.He challenges le Gris, who denies the allegations, to a duel.Not only pride and justice are at stake - if de Carrouges dies, his wife will also die.The spectacular story with stylish photos by Dariusz Wolski is based on facts.The last court duel took place in France in 1386.

programme.title: Ainda Estou Aqui
programme.desc: Brazil, 1971. A military dictatorship is gaining strength in the country, and the lives of citizens are disrupted by detentions, disappearances and acts of violence.In these dangerous times, the Paiva family tries to live a peaceful life in Rio de Janeiro.Everything changes when one day the family patriarch, Rubens (Selton Mello), a former congressman, is summoned for a mysterious interrogation by military investigators.Soon, the officers arrest Eunice Paiva (Fernanda Torres), the mother of the family.She is kept in prison for 12 days and put under pressure to hand over her friends and associates accused of opposition activities.The traumatic experience becomes the beginning of Eunice's profound transformation.After leaving prison, she is forced to find herself again - she fights for the truth as an activist.Its goal is to expose the government's illegal actions and fight for justice for thousands of victims of the regime.

programme.title: Happy Feet
programme.desc: Antarctica.Mambo was born in a land famous for penguins with vocal talent.Singing gives them a sense of community and cements relationships.Unfortunately, Mambo does not have this ability.His mother Norma Jean sees nothing wrong with it, but Memphis' father fears for the future of his son who, due to his inability, may never find his soul mate.The penguin has another valuable gift - he can tap dance perfectly.However, this is not enough for his friend Gloria, the best singer in the area and the leader of the Penguin Empire, who banishes Mamba.He thinks that he doesn't fit in with the rest of the herd.While traveling alone, the exile encounters alien penguins.They are delighted with his tap dancing ability and invite him to their land.There, the penguin discovers a very important truth in life, which says that being yourself is the most important thing.An excellent family film, awarded with an Oscar and a Golden Globe.

programme.title: Queen Of The Ring
programme.desc: 1930s.Single mother Mildred Bliss (Emily Bett Rickards), who has always been interested in sports, dreams of becoming a wrestler.When she meets the promoter of this sport, Billy Wolfe (Josh Lucas), she decides to try her hand at this discipline, although it belongs entirely to men and the law prohibits women from entering the ring.It quickly turns out that he can cope very well, even with players who are more powerful than him.Billy becomes her manager and lover, and soon her husband.The increasingly successful woman adopts the pseudonym Mildred Burke and over time becomes the first millionaire wrestling professional.Unfortunately, her successes in the ring do not go hand in hand with a successful personal life.First of all, her marriage is not a happy one.Based on a true story about the life of women's wrestling pioneer Mildred Burke.

programme.title: Challengers
programme.desc: Tennis player Tashi Duncan (Zendaya) has had impressive success on the court in the past.Her career was ended by an injury.Today, the woman is the trainer of Art Donaldson (Mike Faist) - her partner and father of her daughter.The man is one title short of the Grand Slam, but he is struggling with injury and age, which may ruin the pair's ambitions.After a series of defeats, the player plans to take part in the Challenger tournament in New Rochelle, New York, which is to be his warm-up before the US Open and a chance to regain his form.Unexpectedly, in the finale, Art will have to face Patrick Zweig (Josh O'Connor) - his childhood friend and Tashi's ex-boyfriend.The match becomes an opportunity for all three to confront their turbulent past.The film by Italian director Luca Guadagnino, the creator of the Oscar-nominated "Those Days, Those Nights", is a combination of a sports drama and a story about a love triangle.

credits.actor: US Open line Judge - Scottie DiGiacomo

programme.title: Veep 3
programme.desc: In the third season, vice president Selina Meyer (Julia Louis-Dreyfus) tries for a promotion.To this end, he is trying to win over voters during the premiere of his new book 'Some New Beginnings'.

programme.title: Veep 3
programme.desc: In the third season, vice president Selina Meyer (Julia Louis-Dreyfus) tries for a promotion.To this end, he is trying to win over voters during the premiere of his new book 'Some New Beginnings'.

programme.title: Oscar's Eye
programme.desc: Nine-year-old Oscar cannot speak.Because of this, he is rejected and bullied by his peers.However, he becomes friends with the owner of the workshop, Eric, with whom he shares a common passion - photography.

programme.title: Isle of Dogs
programme.desc: The futuristic city of Megasaki in Japan.In the face of a dog flu epidemic, the corrupt Mayor Kobayashi declares a state of emergency and issues a decree under which all dogs are to be quarantined, i.e. sent to an island covered with garbage.The immediate implementation of the order arouses rebellion in twelve-year-old Atari, who thus loses his four-legged friend.However, the boy does not want to give up so easily, he steals a small flying machine and goes to the island to find Ciapek.Once there, he asks for help from a pack of neglected, hungry dogs who are looking for food among the garbage.Together with his new friends, he sets out to find his ward.The film received two Oscar nominations.He was also nominated, among others:to the Golden Globes and BAFTA awards.The animation director is the winner of many awards, for this production he was also honored with the Silver Bear at the Berlinale festival.

programme.title: Happy Feet Two
programme.desc: Mambo is the most popular tap dancing penguin in Antarctica and he is madly in love with the beautiful Gloria.The fruit of their love is the smart and resolute Eric.The boy, like his father once, tries to find his place in the world.However, it turns out that he does not share his parent's passion - he cannot and does not want to dance.Soon the little rebel meets the charismatic Sven, who can fly.Obsessed with his new idol, he distances himself more and more from his father.Meanwhile, the entire penguin population begins to face great danger.Mambo, with the help of his faithful friends Ramon and Lovelas, decides to fight to restore the old order in a frosty land... A continuation of the Oscar-winning animation about the adventures of an extraordinary penguin.In the Polish language version, the characters were voiced by, among others: Bartosz Obuchowicz, Sonia Bohosiewicz, Cezary Pazura, Tomasz Kot and Wojciech Mecwaldowski.

programme.title: In short
programme.desc: The year 2019, on the threshold of the pandemic.Single woman Ellen (Laura Tonke) spends New Year's Eve with her friends.No one knows that she is having an affair with Sebastian (Ronald Zehrfeld), Eva's (Antje Traue) husband.Rolf (Nicholas Ofczarek) and Dina (Pegah Ferydoni) make a perfect couple, unlike Mareike (Annette Frier) and Adam (Trystan Pütter).Maya (Katia Fellin) wants children, Natalie (Jasmin Shakeri) cannot decide.Max (Henning Flüsloh) comes into Ellen's life and he would love her if she let him.Years pass.The woman attends various types of celebrations, birthday parties and casual social gatherings.He learns about events in his friends' lives.The sense of community unites and allows everyone to return to everyday life with positive energy.Remake of the Danish film "A Long Story Briefly".

programme.title: The Tourist
programme.desc: A man (Jamie Dornan) traveling through the wilderness has an accident.His car is rammed by a tanker and he barely escapes with his life.When he wakes up injured in the hospital, he doesn't remember anything.He doesn't know what happened or who he is.He tries to use all the meetings with people and the clues he receives to discover his identity and past.He must do this before his enemies find him.A suspenseful, full of mysteries story of a man who faces amnesia and a dark past.

credits.actor: Detective Inspector Lachlan Rogers - Damon Herriman

programme.title: Gone Girl
programme.desc: On the day of his fifth wedding anniversary with Amy (Rosamund Pike), Nick Dunne (Ben Affleck) reports to the police that his wife has disappeared in mysterious circumstances.The case of her disappearance quickly reaches the media.Detective Rhonda Boney (Kim Dickens) leading the investigation discovers numerous inconsistencies in the man's testimony.There are speculations that Nick may have had something to do with Amy's mysterious disappearance.Supported by his twin sister, Margo (Carrie Coon), the man desperately tries to prove his innocence.Over time, new facts come to light which show that the Dunnes' marriage was a toxic relationship.The film by the creator of the cult thriller "Seven", David Fincher, was nominated, among others,to the Golden Globe.For her role as Amy, Rosamund Pike received nominations for an Oscar, a Golden Globe and other awards.The film's script, also nominated for a Golden Globe, was based on the best-selling novel by Gillian Flynn.

programme.title: Macbeth
programme.desc: Macbeth returns from his war expedition.The witches predict a great future for him.The man's ambition and lust for power awaken, additionally fueled by his wife.However, his path to the throne will be bloody.

programme.title: Babygirl
programme.desc: Romy (Nicole Kidman) leads a stable and prosperous life.She manages a modern, dynamically developing company, lives in a comfortable house with her devoted husband Jacob (Antonio Banderas) and two teenage daughters.Her everyday life changes when a young intern, Samuel (Harris Dickinson), appears.Despite the age difference, Romy and Samuel begin a fiery romance.The woman begins to rediscover herself, although this decision may mean the loss of both her professional position and her family.She is faced with the decision of whether to follow her own desires, risking everything she has achieved so far.

programme.title: Murder In Glitterball City
programme.desc: Behind the scenes of the crime that took place in 2010 in Louisville, Kentucky.In the basement of the home of Jeffrey Mundt and his boyfriend, Joseph Banis, police found the mutilated body of James Carroll.

programme.title: One, two, three... You're in the game
programme.desc: Salem, Massachusetts, a town marked by a history of witch hunts.Jonah (Benjamin Evan Ainsworth) and his older brother Marcus (Asa Butterfield) come across an abandoned cabin while biking through the forest.They find a diary and a knife with a mysterious inscription on its blade.When read to her, it evokes a demon that forces young people to participate in macabre versions of children's games - from hide and seek to tag.The brothers, their sister Billy (Natalia Dyer) and her friends take part in the bloody showdown.They discover that this competition from hell cannot be won.

programme.title: Noah: Chosen by God
programme.desc: The distant past.Due to the wickedness of Cain's descendants, the inhabitants of large cities, the world is falling into decline.Only representatives of the House of Set still carry out the will of the Creator.One night, former warrior and healer Noah (Russell Crowe) has a terrible dream.He sees it as a gigantic flood that destroys the world.Along with his wife Naameh (Jennifer Connelly) and three sons, he visits his grandfather Methuselah (Anthony Hopkins) to seek his advice.He discovers that his dream is actually a prediction of the great flood.Noah becomes aware that he has been chosen by the Creator to save the lives of innocents.With the help of stone giants called Guardians, he begins work on an ark that will be a shelter for various animal species.Years later, when the specter of disaster becomes more and more real, the huge ship is almost ready.Then the descendant of the first murderer, the self-proclaimed ruler Tubal-kain (Ray Winstone), demands a place in the ark for himself and his subjects.

programme.title: Veep 4
programme.desc: The story of Vice President Selina Meyer (Julia Louis-Dreyfus) continues, as she and her colleagues want to achieve something significant in politics.The woman avoids deals, scandals and corruption.She is assisted in her daily work by Amy, her office manager (Anna Chlumsky), spokesman Mike McLintock (Matt Walsh), general counsel Gary (Tony Hale) and secretary Sue (Sufe Bradshaw).The entire team must contend with the ambitious Dan Egan (Reid Scott) and the confident White House employee Jonah Ryan (Timothy Simons).

programme.title: Veep 4

programme.title: BlacKkKlansman
programme.desc: Early 1970s, Colorado Springs, Colorado.Ron Stallworth (John David Washington) becomes the first black police officer in the department.After encountering manifestations of racism, he asks to be transferred to undercover work.He decides to infiltrate the Ku Klux Klan, but for this he will need the help of an older, white colleague - Flip Zimmerman (Adam Driver).Ron calls representatives of a racist militia on the phone, and Flip meets with them directly.The police obtain information about the Klan's planned attack.Ron contacts David Duke (Topher Grace), the Grand Wizard of the Ku Klux Klan, by phone.Soon, Flip is accepted into the organization.Spike Lee's film won an Oscar for best adapted screenplay in 2019.Starring: versatile supporting actor Adam Driver ("What's Up, Davis?", "Silence") and former American football player John David Washington, Denzel Washington's son, nominated for a Golden Globe for this role.

credits.actor: Master Patrolman Andy Landers - Frederick Weller

programme.title: The Madagascar Penguins in a Christmas Caper
programme.desc: The action of the film is set before the events of the film "Madagascar".The animals at the New York Zoo are getting ready for Christmas.When it's time to celebrate, Skipper, Kowalski and Rico notice that Private is not with them.The penguin wanted to find a gift for his friend, Ted, who was going to spend Christmas alone.Due to an unfortunate turn of events, instead of getting the gift, Private was bought itself.His friends come to his rescue.In the Polish language version, the characters were voiced by, among others:Grzegorz Pawlak, Jacek Lenartowicz, Tomasz Steciuk and Janusz Zadura.

programme.title: Spider-Man: Homecoming
programme.desc: Young Peter Parker is fascinated by the Avengers team.He has the opportunity to experience an amazing adventure alongside his idols and unrivaled role models.After all, the teenager must return home and try to get used to his uninteresting everyday life as an ordinary mortal.He still lives with his good Aunt May, goes to college, and hangs out with friends.At the same time, he remains under the watchful care of Tony Stark, i.e. Iron Man - his mentor and greatest authority.He also tries to fight the pessimistic thoughts that plague him, that no one appreciates his activities, which bring so much benefit to society.Everything changes when it turns out that a new enemy is waiting for the superhero.One day, a dangerous Vulture appears on the boy's path.Peter must stand up for what he loves most.Not only are the lives of his loved ones at risk, but also those of other New York residents.

programme.title: Ford v Ferrari
programme.desc: The victory in the prestigious race goes to the Ferrari team every year.Henry Ford II intends to dethrone the full-time champion.He thinks about building a car that will leave the competition behind.For this purpose, he asks for help from two specialists.One of them is the temperamental fast driving enthusiast Ken Miles.The second one is Carroll Shelby, who can boast of winning Le Mans, and some time ago, due to health problems, he gave up his driving career and took up car design.They both immediately take up the challenge, even though they know that there is a long way to achieve their goal.They quickly encounter resistance from officials.It turns out that they must immerse themselves in the world of ruthless bureaucracy to take part in the twenty-four-hour race.

programme.title: The Fourth Wall
programme.desc: The year 1982, war-torn Lebanon.Theater director Georges (Laurent Lafitte), in order to keep his promise to his terminally ill friend, goes to Beirut to implement a risky project.He intends to put "Antigone" on the front line to guarantee a moment of peace for the parties to the conflict.The show will feature actors involved in fighting, belonging to various political and religious factions.Marwan (Simon Abkarian) becomes a guide in an unknown city, who explains the background of the dispute to the foreigner and becomes a link with the locals.Soon Georges faces the brutal realities of war.The plans are also complicated by the feelings he has for one of the actresses, Imane (Manal Issa).

programme.title: 4 from there
programme.desc: Another installment of the adventures of people living in a town straight from a nightmare.It is a terrifying place that traps anyone who crosses its borders.Desperate residents fight to stay alive.

programme.title: Sellers 3
programme.desc: Randall (Jeff Anderson) has a heart attack.He goes to hospital.A sudden illness makes him take stock of his life.While looking for a new goal, he comes up with the idea of ​​making a film about the Quick Stop store.

programme.title: The Huntsman: Winter's War
programme.desc: Many years before Snow White's birth, Queen Ravenna (Charlize Theron) observes the actions of her sister, Freya (Emily Blunt), who is in love with a man named Andrew.Soon their daughter is born.Shortly thereafter, the child is murdered.At the same time, Freya discovers that she has the power to control ice.The woman leaves Ravenna's lands with a broken heart.He creates his own kingdom and an army of deadly hunters.There is only one rule in their ranks: never to love.It is broken by two warriors - Eric (Chris Hemsworth) and Sara (Jessica Chastain).Freya decides to separate them.Seven years later, after Ravenna's death, Snow White decides to get rid of the evil queen's mirror, moving it to the sanctuary.Some time later, William informs Eric that the soldiers who were responsible for the expedition have gone missing.The hunter suspects Freya - the mirror could significantly increase her power.He agrees to complete the mission, with the help of the dwarves.

programme.title: The Dark Money Game
programme.desc: The filmmakers talk about changes in American law regarding the financing of election campaigns, and examine the boundaries between a political donation and a bribe.In 1975, congress created the Federal Election Commission (FEC), whose task was, among other things,enforcing the law regulating the financing of federal elections.In 2002, a new legal regulation was created, commonly known as the McCain-Feingold Act, which increased the role of private money in running campaigns.A landmark decision, called Citizens United, was issued in 2010 by the US Supreme Court, abolishing all limits on transferring funds to a selected candidate or political party.

programme.title: Barry 2
programme.sub-title: Past = Present x Future Over Yesterday
programme.desc: Further adventures of Barry Berkman, a former Marine and murderer who discovers his passion for acting.He is faced with the consequences of his previous decisions, including:murder of a friend.

programme.title: Barry 2
programme.desc: Further adventures of Barry Berkman, a former Marine and murderer who discovers his passion for acting.He is faced with the consequences of his previous decisions, including:murder of a friend.

programme.title: Summer School, 2001
programme.desc: Kien returns to Cheb in the Czech Republic, where his relatives run a stall at the market.His appearance changes the family's life.

programme.title: Summer Camp
programme.desc: As children, Ginny (Kathy Bates), Nora (Diane Keaton) and Mary (Alfre Woodard) spent every summer together.When, after 50 years, there is an opportunity to meet again - at a summer camp meeting, the friends decide to take advantage of it, although with varying levels of enthusiasm.The least satisfied with her holidays is workaholic Nora, who feels best in her own company.Despite this, she and her friends take on new challenges, such as rafting or a rope park.Additionally, there, the woman meets her former lover, Stevie D (Eugene Levy).Thanks to him and the camp atmosphere, things start to change.

programme.title: Good Guy With A Gun
programme.desc: After the violent death of his father, teenage Will (Beck Nolan) and his mother, Tessa Greenwood (Tiffany Bedwell), move to a small town in Illinois.There is a house they inherited from an ancestor, which the woman intends to sell.There, Will meets boys his own age and quickly becomes friends with them.The new friends are fascinated by the weapons each of them has and spend time practicing their shooting skills.Will begins to share their passion, which even worsens his already not good relationship with his mother, complicates the mourning for his father, and even puts the boy's life in danger.

programme.title: Rooster
programme.desc: Greg Russo (Steve Carell) has written a best-selling series of books, and readers identify him with his literary hero nicknamed Rooster.A famous writer comes to the university campus to support his daughter (Charly Clive) who is going through a marital crisis in a difficult moment.Her partner has just left her for a student, which everyone knows perfectly well.The situation is further complicated by scandals involving a woman who are the subject of gossip in the academic community.The father declares help, but his presence quickly reveals old conflicts and uncomfortable topics, instead of bringing the expected solution.

programme.title: Comeback 3
programme.desc: Valerie Cherish, a once popular television actress, rose to fame as a sitcom star.After many years, he wants to return to the small screen at all costs.He decides to take part in a new reality show.

programme.title: The Knick
programme.desc: New York, the first years of the 20th century.Brilliant surgeon Dr. John Thackery (Clive Owen) leads a brave team of young medics at Knickerbocker Hospital.The doctor introduces pioneering medical solutions while struggling with cocaine addiction.His team is making breakthroughs in medicine at a time when antibiotics do not yet exist and patient mortality is terrifyingly high.The group of distinguished medical staff includes, among others:protégé Everett Gallinger (Eric Johnson) and Algernon Edwards (Andre Holland), a promising surgeon from Europe who was included in the team against Thackery's wishes.The series is directed by Oscar winner Steven Soderbergh.

programme.title: Caught Stealing
programme.desc: 1990s. Former baseball player Hank Thompson (Austin Butler) works as a bartender in a New York pub.He has a great girlfriend (Zoë Kravitz) and a championship-fighting team.His calm and orderly life changes when his neighbor Russ (Matt Smith) asks him to look after his cat for a few days.Then, out of nowhere, a gang of gangsters attacks Hank.Puerto Ricans, Russians and Jews are out to get him and he has no idea why.He will only find out what's going on if his wits and luck allow him to stay alive long enough.

programme.title: Half Man
programme.desc: 1980s. The life of bullied teenage Niall (Mitchell Robertson) turns upside down when the son of his mother's partner, the fierce and unpredictable Ruben (Stuart Campbell), comes to live with them for a while.Even though they are not related by blood, over time they both become inseparable.However, subsequent events make them move away from each other.Three decades later, Ruben (Richard Gadd) shows up uninvited at Niall's (Jamie Bell) wedding.It soon becomes clear why he reconnected with his long-lost brother.A suggestive story about the fragility of male relationships, brotherhood, betrayal, loyalty and violence.

programme.title: On Swift Horses
programme.desc: 1950s. Newlyweds Muriel (Daisy Edgar-Jones) and Lee (Will Poulter) move from Kansas to San Diego, where a new home and job awaits them.At this time, the man's brother, Julius (Jacob Elordi), who has just returned from the Korean War, reappears in their lives.The former veteran is an accomplished poker player.So he goes to Las Vegas, where he supervises a casino and becomes friends with another gaming enthusiast, Henry (Diego Calva).All this time, she corresponds by letter with her sister-in-law.The woman, bored with her everyday life, is fascinated by the world of gambling in which her brother-in-law operates.Under his influence, he secretly begins betting on horse races.She soon leaves her husband and sets off on an exciting journey together with his brother.

programme.title: BlacKkKlansman
programme.desc: Early 1970s, Colorado Springs, Colorado.Ron Stallworth (John David Washington) becomes the first black police officer in the department.After encountering manifestations of racism, he asks to be transferred to undercover work.He decides to infiltrate the Ku Klux Klan, but for this he will need the help of an older, white colleague - Flip Zimmerman (Adam Driver).Ron calls representatives of a racist militia on the phone, and Flip meets with them directly.The police obtain information about the Klan's planned attack.Ron contacts David Duke (Topher Grace), the Grand Wizard of the Ku Klux Klan, by phone.Soon, Flip is accepted into the organization.Spike Lee's film won an Oscar for best adapted screenplay in 2019.Starring: versatile supporting actor Adam Driver ("What's Up, Davis?", "Silence") and former American football player John David Washington, Denzel Washington's son, nominated for a Golden Globe for this role.

programme.title: Summer Camp
programme.desc: As children, Ginny (Kathy Bates), Nora (Diane Keaton) and Mary (Alfre Woodard) spent every summer together.When, after 50 years, there is an opportunity to meet again - at a summer camp meeting, the friends decide to take advantage of it, although with varying levels of enthusiasm.The least satisfied with her holidays is workaholic Nora, who feels best in her own company.Despite this, she and her friends take on new challenges, such as rafting or a rope park.Additionally, there, the woman meets her former lover, Stevie D (Eugene Levy).Thanks to him and the camp atmosphere, things start to change.

programme.title: A Picture Of Her
programme.desc: Beth (Rhiannon Fish) works as first mate on a fishing vessel.He goes ashore for a while to take care of his aunt (Samantha Ferris), who has broken her leg.During her daily shopping, photographer Jake (Tyler Hynes) secretly takes a photo of her choosing flowers.A freelancer sends a photograph of a stranger to a newspaper under a pseudonym.Some time later, Beth and Jake meet in person.They both turn out to be dog lovers, and over time they discover that they have a lot in common.The lovers' relationship is getting closer.Then Beth's photo appears on the cover of a magazine and goes viral, making her very popular.The woman wants to find the author, meanwhile Jake does not have the courage to confess the truth.

programme.title: The Last Vermeer
programme.desc: The Netherlands after World War II.The accountability of Nazi criminals and their accomplices continues.A Jew, Joseph Piller (Claes Bang), who fought in the resistance movement, is to deal with the case of stolen works of art.He accuses the eccentric painter Han van Meegeren (Guy Pearce) of collaboration, who hosted Germans at his home for hedonistic parties and sold them valuable paintings.The artist faces a death sentence.However, he claims that he traded in fakes he created.His exquisitely crafted fakes are indistinguishable from the originals.Although the evidence points to van Meegeren's guilt, and accepting his version would make the brilliant forger a national hero, Piller begins to believe him.Together with her assistant (Vicky Krieps), she tries to prove his innocence, putting her career and good name on the line.Based on facts, the extraordinary story of a Dutch painter and one of the best art forgers in history.It was based on the biography of Han van Meegeren by Jonathan Lopez.

programme.title: Trolls
programme.desc: Trolls are cheerful, singing and fabulously colorful creatures that live in a colorful forest.None of them have any idea what the world around them is like.Poppy displays their positive attitude the most.Her carefreeness and joy is shared by everyone, except Mruk.The troll believes that his brethren are in danger.These words come true when the village of nice creatures is found by their greatest enemies, the Bergens.All of Poppy's friends are kidnapped and she must set out to rescue them.She is accompanied by Mruk, who is reluctant to leave his house.In the Polish language version, the characters were voiced by, among others: Magdalena Wasylik, Piotr Bajtlik, Ewa Konstancja Bułhak and Bartosz Obuchowicz.

programme.title: Infinitely Polar Bear
programme.desc: 1970s, Boston.Cam Stuart (Mark Ruffalo) suffers from bipolar disorder.Due to his illness, he had to be hospitalized and lost his job.One day, his wife, nurse Maggie (Zoe Saldana), accepts a scholarship to New York University.The MBA degree obtained there will help her find a well-paid job, thanks to which she will provide for her family and take care of her children's education.While staying in another city, her husband has to take care of his daughters - adolescent Amelia (Imogene Wolodarsky) and Faith (Ashley Aufderheide).He faces an exceptionally difficult task.Girls are often embarrassed by the behavior of their father, who keeps coming up with various unusual ideas.However, they help him face everyday challenges.

programme.title: Widow Clicquot
programme.desc: France at the turn of the 18th and 19th centuries.Twenty-year-old Barbe-Nicole Ponsardin (Haley Bennett) becomes the wife of François Clicquot (Tom Sturridge), a descendant of a family of winemakers.Although the marriage was arranged, they share great love.They also run a business together, and the woman is fascinated by her beloved's avant-garde approach to the methods of producing alcohol.Unfortunately, their happiness is disturbed by the man's sudden death.Despite the pain of losing her loved one, 27-year-old Barbe-Nicole, mother of Clémentine (Cecily Cleeve), is determined to manage the vineyard as a single woman, contrary to custom.She wants to continue implementing her husband's modern theories on viticulture and bottling techniques, and prepare her own blend of sparkling wine.To win, she must not be defeated by the capricious weather that threatens her harvest, the ruthless Jean-Remy Moët (Nicholas Farrell) who wants to deprive her of her business, or even the state that has the Napoleonic Code, which prohibits women from running a business.Based on the true story of a woman called the "grand lady of Champagne", who created the famous Veuve Clicquot brand and was one of the first businesswomen in the world.

programme.title: The Knick
programme.desc: New York, the first years of the 20th century.Brilliant surgeon Dr. John Thackery (Clive Owen) leads a brave team of young medics at Knickerbocker Hospital.The doctor introduces pioneering medical solutions while struggling with cocaine addiction.His team is making breakthroughs in medicine at a time when antibiotics do not yet exist and patient mortality is terrifyingly high.The group of distinguished medical staff includes, among others:protégé Everett Gallinger (Eric Johnson) and Algernon Edwards (Andre Holland), a promising surgeon from Europe who was included in the team against Thackery's wishes.The series is directed by Oscar winner Steven Soderbergh.

programme.title: The Price of Glee
programme.desc: Called a phenomenon and showered with awards, the series "Glee" has forever become a part of the history of American television.Thanks to him, many young actors had an open door to their career.Unfortunately, for some it was the beginning of the end... Today it is known that fate hung over the cast of the show.The first tragedy occurred during the shooting.On July 13, 2013, the star of the production, 31-year-old Cory Monteith, was found dead in a hotel in Vancouver.The cause of death was given as a drug overdose.Then - three years after the last episode of "Glee" aired, in 2018 - the young actor's co-star, Mark Salling, took his own life.In 2020, the media reported the death of another artist associated with the musical, Naya Rivera.The creators of the documentary show the behind-the-scenes life of the cast of the hit, as well as, among others:conversations with Monteith's roommate and Rivera's father.Everyone is looking for an answer to the question: why the success of "Glee" turned out to be both a blessing and a curse.

programme.title: Recipe For Love
programme.desc: In Onjeong Market, located in Onjeong, a town some distance away from Seoul, the area is buzzing with change as apartment complexes are built and plans for subway extensions and new town developments are announced. Across a single street stand a principled general hospital, Gongmyeongjeongdae Clinic, and traditional Korean clinic, Yangji Barun Clinic. The two families who run these places have been bitter enemies for years, bound by a long standing grudge from an incident in the past. Even the smallest matters turn into big fights, making them the most famous rival families in Onjeong. This is a family growth drama about these two families as they unravel their long held misunderstandings, heal their wounds, learn to love one another, and are reborn as one family.

programme.title: Great Parks of Africa
programme.desc: In a park where land meets sea, the natural elements combine to create wonderful variety. Cola-colored water feeds forests green and dense. Fire and wind fuel growth in great diversity and rock shapes a coastline of many faces. Life thrives here - from the magnificent to the bizarre. This is the Garden Route National Park.

programme.title: Orangutan Jungle School
programme.desc: Beni and Lala get an unexpected visit from Vet Arga, Kesi makes a new friend on Bangamat Island, and Alejandra deals with a new view of the world after the accident at forest school leaves her blind in one eye.

programme.title: Arctic Secrets
programme.desc: The Yukon is a true wilderness, one of the last on Earth. The vast land got its name from its longest river, which the Gwich’in, one of the indigenous people of the region, call 'Yu-kun- ah', or, the 'great river'. The third longest waterway in North America, the Yukon River flows through wide open valleys and narrow channels over 3,000 km Northwest towards the storm tossed Bering Sea.

programme.title: Chasing the Rains
programme.desc: Travel to Samburu, where matriarch Anastasia turns her elephant herd north after a local river dries up. Then, in Naboisho, see cheetah mom Kuleta evade a crafty pack of hyenas. Later, in Laikipia, check in on wild dog Phoenix and her new litter.

credits.director: Justin Purefoy: Director & DOP; Adjoa Andoh: Narrator

programme.title: Chasing the Rains
programme.desc: Discover the clever way elephants dig wells, and see the relief that comes with a sudden river-filling downpour. Mourn cheetah Kuleta’s loss after lions kill one of her cubs, and get a front-row seat when wild dog Phoenix faces off with a hyena mob.

credits.director: Justin Purefoy: Director & DOP; Adjoa Andoh: Narrator

programme.title: Wildlife ER
programme.desc: Stand by as rescue officers use a technique called flagging to nab a koala with dangerously inflamed eyes. Soothe burned possum feet with vet Tim, then shadow vet Karina as she examines a half-drowned platypus before referring him to a specialist.

credits.director: Annie Gray: Series Producer, Justine Clark: Narrator

programme.title: Arctic Secrets
programme.desc: It’s November at Cape Tatnam. Winter is coming to the lower Western shore of Hudson Bay. But the ice - which should be forming on Hudson Bay by now - is nowhere to be seen. 2016 has been the warmest year on record. In late November, the temperature is 10 degrees warmer than its average. Climate change is wreaking havoc across the North. At just below zero degrees Celsius, the sea cannot freeze.

programme.title: Lost Treasures of The Maya
programme.desc: Albert Lin spent many months in the Guatemalan jungle in the company of an international team of scientists.He recorded material at twelve major archaeological sites.The researchers had at their disposal a LiDAR device that works similarly to an X-ray.It allowed the terrain to be scanned from the air.Thanks to this, a digital map was developed.A special application was also created showing the local landscape without forests.Therefore, there was no need to cut down the trees.Objects that were part of previously unknown cities were found, including pyramids and a fortified citadel.They also found the skeleton of the queen, the ruler's burial chamber with richly decorated ritual vessels, fragments of the skull of a sacrificed child, bas-reliefs, a stone altar, a painted vase, as well as dozens of statuettes and ceramic objects.The discoveries made allowed us to re-evaluate the current knowledge about the Mayan civilization.

programme.title: Goulag: Une histoire soviétique

programme.title: Lost Ships of WW2
programme.desc: Just before the end of World War II, the cruiser USS Indianapolis sank after being torpedoed by a Japanese submarine.About 900 sailors found themselves in the open ocean.Hungry and cold, they fought for survival for five days.Some fell victim to sharks.Over 300 people were rescued.Books have been written about the disaster, documentaries have been made, and in 2016, the war drama "The Last Mission of the USS Indianapolis" with Nicolas Cage in the main role was premiered.This time, viewers will learn not only the shocking story of the survivors, but also the circumstances of finding the legendary wreck.Epilogue of war history To accurately present the fate of the cruiser and its crew, documentarians used archival film materials, computer animations, expert statements and moving accounts of miraculously survived sailors, including Edgar "Ed" Harrell.Thanks to this, viewers can feel the horror of the events of 1945.The wreck of the USS Indianapolis rested at the bottom of the Philippine Sea at a depth of over 5.5 km.Only 72 years after the tragedy, members of Paul Allen's expedition managed to locate it.Thanks to this, it was possible to write an epilogue to the story about the greatest maritime disaster in the history of the United States Navy.

programme.desc: As Death Eaters wreak havoc in both Muggle and Wizard worlds, Hogwarts is no longer a safe haven for students. Though Harry suspects there are new dangers lurking within the castle walls, Dumbledore is more intent than ever on preparing the young wizard for the final battle with Voldemort. Teenage hormones run rampant through Hogwarts, presenting a different sort of danger. Love may be in the air, but tragedy looms and Hogwarts may never be the same again.

Together the unlikely trio ventures into hostile territory to dispense some Old West justice.

Funded by MacGregor (Robert Stack), a wealthy executive also looking for his son, Rhodes leads his men on a dangerous mission into the jungles of Laos.

programme.title: Woman at the end of the world
programme.desc: Martyna Wojciechowska once again sets out on a fascinating journey to learn about different aspects of the lives of women living in distant corners of the world.Some of the points of the route in this edition will be India, Senegal, South Korea, South Africa, Israel and Mexico.The program participants will talk about their everyday lives and reveal intimate secrets to the traveler.Some of them will be truly moving.This season, the journalist will look at how the Orthodox Jewish community functions on a daily basis and how they celebrate the joyful holiday of Purim.He will visit a nursing home for women who were once involved in prostitution.Although this profession is legal in Mexico, women are not entitled to any benefits.The traveler will also meet teenage Karolina, who works almost 24 hours a day at a garbage dump, and in South Africa she will meet a girl who dives with sharks.These are just some of the many amazing experiences that await Martyna Wojciechowska Martyna Wojciechowska visits South Korea, a country that has one of the lowest fertility rates in the world.According to research, as much as 90 percentmen and 80 percentwomen between 25 and 30 are single.Women fear that marriage and pregnancy will stand in the way of their advancement at work and will be a reason for discrimination.On the other hand, South Korea is a conservative country and almost every woman wants to get married.For this reason, the business of solo weddings is booming here.It turns out that young Korean women do not even need a partner to fulfill their dreams of a white dress and a veil.

programme.title: Taste the world with Pascal
programme.desc: Pascal Brodnicki likes to explore the world through his sense of taste.He loves to prepare various dishes at street stalls, in African villages or on the beach. However, during his culinary journeys it was not always easy for him.Sometimes elephants stole his ingredients.Of course, Pascal couldn't deny himself the pleasure of tasting local delicacies.In Delhi, he stopped for a long time at a paratha stand, in a Zanzibar village he ate rice with coconut, and in Namibia he tried a zebra steak."Taste the world with Pascal" is not only about cooking.The host visited an elephant orphanage in Sri Lanka, fed cheetahs in Africa and climbed a coconut tree.In Bombay he became a teacher and taught Polish to children, and on the coast of Zanzibar he hunted octopus.Everywhere his passion and positive energy attracted crowds of onlookers.

programme.title: Woman at the end of the world
programme.desc: A series of reports presenting the customs and life situation of women living in distant corners of the globe.Journalist Martyna Wojciechowska once again sets out on risky expeditions to learn about the activities, passions and dreams of women living in different cultures.Stops in the third edition of the program include Samoa, Ghana and India.Together with her interlocutors, she experiences their joys and sorrows and participates in everyday activities.This allows her to understand contrasts and learn about different approaches to femininity in different parts of the world During her trip to India, Martyna Wojciechowska meets a family who, according to Hindu tradition, takes care of the Karni Mata temple in Rajasthan.The religious building is inhabited by over 20,000 rats, which are the incarnations of clan members.Manisha and Diksha take care of the rodents and provide them with food.Martyna also meets Ćitra, who tells her about her first meeting with her husband and shows her the typical outfit of Indian women - a colorful sari.Then, under the supervision of a hairdresser working in the middle of the street, the traveler takes on the role of a barber.

programme.title: Woman at the end of the world
programme.desc: A series of reports presenting the customs and life situation of women living in distant corners of the globe.Journalist Martyna Wojciechowska once again sets out on risky expeditions to learn about the activities, passions and dreams of women living in different cultures.Stops in the third edition of the program include Samoa, Ghana and India.Together with her interlocutors, she experiences their joys and sorrows and participates in everyday activities.This allows her to understand contrasts and learn about different approaches to femininity in different parts of the world While traveling through picturesque Polynesia, Martyna Wojciechowska meets another fascinating heroine.In Samoa, the role one plays in the community is more important than gender and appearance.Boys can decide whether they want to become men and heads of the family, or choose a different life scenario - become fa'afafine.This term describes people who combine features of both sexes.Martyna visited Vaitoe Toelupe, a 26-year-old fa'afafine who is responsible for coordinating rescue services in the event of various disasters, and after work she designs women's clothes.Alex K'Sua, on the other hand, is the first fa'afafine lawyer in Samoa's history.

programme.title: The Extraordinary States of Procopius
programme.desc: Marcin Prokop sets off overseas once again.According to the stereotype, the United States is a place of endless possibilities, where everyone can fulfill their dreams.In the new season of the program, the host will meet people who have found the recipe for success in life.In this way, he wants to find out whether there is a set of universal rules that guarantee happiness.He will visit, among others, the Skid Row district in Los Angeles, the NASA headquarters in Pasadena, the desert in Utah and a gold mine in Colorado.In each episode, viewers will discover new stories and places The host visits the Dixie Dude Ranch, which was created for tourists.You can ride a horse here, feel like a resident of the prairie and experience the cowboy life.There are dozens of similar places in Texas.Marcin Prokop will try to find out whether they show the truth about the everyday life of the inhabitants of this part of America.There will also be a Polish accent.In the nearby town of Bandera there is a church built by Poles, where the parish priest is an emigrant from Silesia.Finally, a meeting with Ezekiel Mitchell, a professional bull rider, who will tell the host where his fascination with this dangerous sport comes from.

programme.title: The Extraordinary States of Procopius
programme.desc: Marcin Prokop sets off overseas once again.According to the stereotype, the United States is a place of endless possibilities, where everyone can fulfill their dreams.In the new season of the program, the host will meet people who have found the recipe for success in life.In this way, he wants to find out whether there is a set of universal rules that guarantee happiness.He will visit, among others, the Skid Row district in Los Angeles, the NASA headquarters in Pasadena, the desert in Utah and a gold mine in Colorado.In each episode, viewers will discover new stories and places Gold diggers still inhabit Colorado.One of them is Kevin Singel, who in a conversation with Marcin Prokop will reveal whether the stories about overnight fortunes are true and how much the largest piece of precious metal he has found is worth.The host will also visit the mine of Jesse Patterson, who is considered a legend among the local gold prospectors.The man will try to teach Marcin a professional technique for rinsing stones and will talk about what he learned from the Poles he met many years ago.Finally, on the outskirts of Denver, Marcin will discover a real treasure - an extraordinary store resembling a museum of the 1980s.This visit will turn out to be a real journey back in time.

programme.title: The Extraordinary States of Procopius
programme.desc: Marcin Prokop sets off overseas once again.According to the stereotype, the United States is a place of endless possibilities, where everyone can fulfill their dreams.In the new season of the program, the host will meet people who have found the recipe for success in life.In this way, he wants to find out whether there is a set of universal rules that guarantee happiness.He will visit, among others, the Skid Row district in Los Angeles, the NASA headquarters in Pasadena, the desert in Utah and a gold mine in Colorado.In each episode, viewers will discover new stories and places In this episode, Marcin Prokop sets off on a journey to Silicon Valley.But first, he will visit Sausalito, a city called the Venice of America.In this unique place, houses are built on the water, and residents are separated from the bustling San Francisco by a trip over the Golden Gate Bridge.However, in the heart of Silicon Valley there is Stanford University.This prestigious university counts among its graduates, among others, Elon Musk.This is where Han will tell the host about how to create your own company in the center of American technological thought.Marcin Prokop will also meet Jakub Pachocki.This will be a great opportunity to ask one of the creators of ChatGPT a few questions generated by this tool.

programme.title: The Extraordinary States of Procopius
programme.desc: Marcin Prokop sets off overseas once again.According to the stereotype, the United States is a place of endless possibilities, where everyone can fulfill their dreams.In the new season of the program, the host will meet people who have found the recipe for success in life.In this way, he wants to find out whether there is a set of universal rules that guarantee happiness.He will visit, among others, the Skid Row district in Los Angeles, the NASA headquarters in Pasadena, the desert in Utah and a gold mine in Colorado.In each episode, viewers will discover new stories and places Opened in 1894, Huntsville Prison is an institution where over 580 people lost their lives.Executions of convicts were carried out using an electric chair, which can now be seen as a museum exhibit.David Stacks, a former prison guard, will talk about working there and the emotions that accompany meetings with the most dangerous criminals in America.Jimi Willet, former prison warden and execution supervisor, will reveal whether he ever managed to get used to death.Marcin will also ask him about the impact his job has on his family life.

programme.title: Men, Women, Wild
programme.desc: Three couples, husband and wife, mother and father, and a boy and a girl, set off on an extreme expedition.For three weeks they try to survive in the most dangerous places on the planet.

programme.title: Marooned with Ed Stafford 2
programme.desc: Former British Army captain and experienced traveler Ed Stafford continues to overcome new challenges.He became known to viewers as a steadfast man who is able to cope with any extreme situation.So far, among others:he underwent a test of survival for 60 days on one of the uninhabited islands of Fiji, where he had no supplies of food, clothing or necessary equipment.Moreover, he walked the trail leading along the Amazon River, which earned him a place in history and the Guinness Book of Records.In the next series of the program "Ed Stafford Beyond Civilization", the traveler once again sets off to the most hostile corners of the world, including the Gobi Desert in Mongolia and the crocodile-infested Guatemalan jungle.

programme.title: Man v Food 2
programme.desc: Adam sets off on a journey across the United States to take part in subsequent rounds of timed eating competitions.Adam will take on Badass Burrito in Las Vegas and a 106-centimetre pizza in San Antonio.

programme.title: Woman at the end of the world
programme.desc: Martyna Wojciechowska has been wandering the world for many years and looking for interesting people who share their unique stories with her.The traveler not only talks about their everyday lives, but also raises important social issues.In the tenth season of the program he will visit, among others:Spitsbergen - the largest island of the Svalbard archipelago, where it is night for a quarter of the year.He will also reach out to the Wodaabe community living in Chad, and in El Salvador he will tackle the difficult issue of restrictive anti-abortion regulations. Martyna Wojciechowska breaks stereotypes.In the Wodaabe community of Chad, men court women.For this reason, they attach great importance to their appearance.They put on their best clothes and do their makeup.Their chosen ones are only supposed to observe and then decide.The best place to look for a husband is the Gerewol Festival.The episode's heroine, Fatima, chose Haire last year.According to tradition, their wedding should take place on the anniversary of the happy event.A few months ago, the woman gave birth to a daughter.They only see each other in secret, because only such meetings are allowed.A man can have several wives, but he must pay appropriately for a good partner.Among the Wodaabe, the greatest wealth is cows.Haire's parents gave five cows and several million Central African francs for Fatima.

programme.title: Woman at the end of the world
programme.desc: Martyna Wojciechowska has been wandering the world for many years and looking for interesting people who share their unique stories with her.The traveler not only talks about their everyday lives, but also raises important social issues.In the tenth season of the program he will visit, among others:Spitsbergen - the largest island of the Svalbard archipelago, where it is night for a quarter of the year.He will also reach out to the Wodaabe community living in Chad, and in El Salvador he will tackle the difficult issue of restrictive anti-abortion regulations. Martyna Wojciechowska spent six hundred and fifty days traveling, during which she visited fifty countries.This is how eighty episodes of the program were created.Over the ten years of the series, she has made many new friends, and many of the characters still hold a special place in her heart.They include Kabula - an albino girl from Tanzania.Thanks to the money collected by viewers and the "Between Heaven and Earth" foundation, she was able to fulfill her dreams.She started studying at a private school in Mwanza.Now he is doing everything he can to become a lawyer and defend the rights of people with albinism.She spent her last holidays in Poland, with Martyna Wojciechowska.Viewers will see how this first visit went.

programme.title: Woman at the end of the world
programme.desc: Martyna Wojciechowska once again sets out on a fascinating journey to learn about different aspects of the lives of women living in distant corners of the world.Some of the points of the route in this edition will be India, Senegal, South Korea, South Africa, Israel and Mexico.The program participants will talk about their everyday lives and reveal intimate secrets to the traveler.Some of them will be truly moving.This season, the journalist will look at how the Orthodox Jewish community functions on a daily basis and how they celebrate the joyful holiday of Purim.He will visit a nursing home for women who were once involved in prostitution.Although this profession is legal in Mexico, women are not entitled to any benefits.The traveler will also meet teenage Karolina, who works almost 24 hours a day at a garbage dump, and in South Africa she will meet a girl who dives with sharks.These are just some of the many amazing experiences that await Martyna Wojciechowska Martyna Wojciechowska visits South Korea, a country that has one of the lowest fertility rates in the world.According to research, as much as 90 percentmen and 80 percentwomen between 25 and 30 are single.Women fear that marriage and pregnancy will stand in the way of their advancement at work and will be a reason for discrimination.On the other hand, South Korea is a conservative country and almost every woman wants to get married.For this reason, the business of solo weddings is booming here.It turns out that young Korean women do not even need a partner to fulfill their dreams of a white dress and a veil.

programme.title: Woman at the end of the world
programme.desc: Martyna Wojciechowska once again sets out on a fascinating journey to learn about different aspects of the lives of women living in distant corners of the world.Some of the points of the route in this edition will be India, Senegal, South Korea, South Africa, Israel and Mexico.The program participants will talk about their everyday lives and reveal intimate secrets to the traveler.Some of them will be truly moving.This season, the journalist will look at how the Orthodox Jewish community functions on a daily basis and how they celebrate the joyful holiday of Purim.He will visit a nursing home for women who were once involved in prostitution.Although this profession is legal in Mexico, women are not entitled to any benefits.The traveler will also meet teenage Karolina, who works almost 24 hours a day at a garbage dump, and in South Africa she will meet a girl who dives with sharks.These are just some of the many amazing experiences that await Martyna Wojciechowska Martyna Wojciechowska's goal is Mexico.This is the country where most disappearances of women occur.Kidnapped or lured, they become part of one of the most profitable businesses - prostitution.The traveler visits the nursing home intended for them.Professional sex work is legal in Mexico, but women who engage in it cannot count on any pension or health benefits.At Casa Xochiquetzal, Martyna Wojciechowska talks to eighteen residents and the director of the home, who fights for them to age with dignity and to experience warmth.

programme.title: The Extraordinary States of Procopius
programme.desc: Boston is a city of great historical and scientific importance.This is where prestigious universities such as Harvard and MIT are located, as well as the headquarters of Boston Dynamics, known for creating humanoid robots.Although the city is associated with the American Revolution, it also has lesser-known stories.Marcin will meet a guide who will talk about the first settlers and explain events such as the flooding of the city by molasses in the early 20th century, the smell of which can still be felt on hot days.Marcin will also talk to Walter Robinson from the Boston Globe about the famous journalistic investigation presented in the film "Spotlight", which revealed a scandal in the local archdiocese, affecting the city and the world.In addition, the host will take viewers to Salem, a town known for its witch trials from three hundred years ago.Today, the Salem witches attract tourists and are one of the area's main attractions.

programme.title: The Extraordinary States of Procopius
programme.desc: Horror is currently one of the most profitable genres in literature and film.Novels such as "Carrie", "Salem's Salem" and "The Shining" are considered horror classics.Their author, Stephen King, sets most of his stories in the quiet corners of Maine.Marcin Prokop visits King's hometown to understand how the environment in which the writer grew up influenced his extraordinary ability to create terrifying stories.These places are characterized by beautiful nature and peace, which attracts tourists away from the hustle and bustle of the city, creating an image of an American idyll.Marcin wants to discover what in this setting could have inspired King to write and whether the town of Derry, famous for his works, really exists under a different name.

programme.title: A Clear Shot
programme.desc: A hostage situation at the Good Guys electronic store in Sacramento California goes awry when bullets start flying. Will law enforcement be able to come in and save the day or will the hostage takers win.

programme.title: Swimfan
programme.desc: It's a teen thriller kind of like 'Fatal Attraction' where a high school senior who's rising in the swimming world has a one-night hookup that leads to some bad stuff...

programme.title: The Lady Vanishes
programme.desc: While travelling in continental Europe, a rich young playgirl realizes that an elderly lady seems to have disappeared from the train.

programme.title: Sincerely, Yours, Truly
programme.desc: Hayley stumbles upon a bundle of letters with an engagement ring from a mysterious sender, she decides to respond to him with her own alias, and with it start the anonymous correspondence that will change her life forever.

programme.title: Starting Up Love
programme.desc: When workaholic Jillian gets a note that her long-lost, wealthy uncle has passed away, she finds he’s left her his beautiful mountainside cabin – and a family she never knew existed. Jillian’s plan is to sell the cabin as soon as possible and move on, but when she meets handsome caretaker Liam, he makes her an offer she can’t refuse. Sparks fly as they work together to transform the cabin into a holiday resort. When business doesn’t go as planned and she almost loses her newfound family, Jillian needs to make a decision. Will she give up everything for the love she never saw coming?

programme.title: Spitfire
programme.desc: R. J. Mitchell, a patriotic aircraft designer, was concerned about the rise of German military power and dedicated himself to creating a defense against the German Messerschmidt, ultimately sacrificing his health. AKA The First of the Few

programme.title: Deadly Inferno
programme.desc: During some extensive renovations on an eight-storey office building, a major gas leak leads to a terrible explosion, trapping the injured staff in a fiery maze. Can the brave firefighters provide a safe exit from this deadly inferno?

programme.title: Dragon Warriors
programme.desc: Dragons, warriors, orcs, bounty hunters, goblins, wizards, elves, witches, maidens in distress, beautiful princesses, romance, true love, betrayal and magic come together when an unlikely group of heroes embark on a quest to save the land from an evil wizard who has sent a fire-breathing dragon to kill everyone in his realm who has fallen in love.

programme.title: Killer in Suburbia
programme.desc: Gina and her teenage daughter Kelsey move into a new town so Kelsey can attend a better high school. It’s the start of senior year - meaning new parties to attend and new friends to make. But when Kelsey is abducted while on a date, all Gina’s nightmares come true. Can she save her daughter in time? And can she really trust the people trying to help?

programme.title: Bang Bang You're Dead
programme.desc: A group of six travelers hop on the bus from Casablanca airport headed to Marrakesh. Among them, someone has $2 million intended for a local operator to influence United Nations votes. But who's the person? AKA Our Man in Marrakesh

programme.title: The Cat and the Canary
programme.desc: A group of potential heirs gather in a forbidding old house to learn which of them will inherit a fortune. Later, they learn that a flesh-rending maniac is loose.

programme.title: The Hit
programme.desc: Ten years after Willie Parker snitched on his mob buddies for his own protection, a couple of hitmen kidnap him and take him to Paris where they plan to execute him. But along the journey, they run into all sorts of problems.

programme.title: No Man of God
programme.desc: The complex relationship that developed between FBI analyst Bill Hagmaier and serial killer Ted Bundy during Bundy's last years on death row.
